drafts.text:
HOOK
German inflation is back, and European markets could see an immediate reaction.
[ON SCREEN: EUR/USD and DAX price tickers]
WHAT IT IS
Germany reports preliminary annual inflation for Nov at 08:00 ET. Consensus is looking for 3.0%, up from 2.8% last month.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 3.0% vs Previous 2.8%]
WHY IT MATTERS
Germany is Europe's economic powerhouse, so this release shapes European Central Bank policy expectations. That makes it a major mover for both EUR/USD and the DAX. Rising inflation pressures the central bank to stay tight, which directly impacts currency strength and equity valuations.
[ON SCREEN: ECB building and DAX chart]
WHAT TO WATCH
If the data beats 3.0%, the euro could see quick upside as rate bets firm up. A print below expectations could relieve pressure and lift the DAX.
[ON SCREEN: Hotter CPI vs Cooler CPI scenarios]
CLOSE
You can find the full breakdown and live coverage on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]

drafts.text:
HOOK
Canadian growth is in the spotlight, and the Loonie could be gearing up for a volatile morning.
[ON SCREEN: Tiger to camera with "Canada GDP Alert"]

WHAT IT IS
Canada drops its Q3 GDP growth numbers at 08:30 ET. Consensus points to 0.3%, which would mark a slowdown from the previous 0.8%.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 0.3% vs Previous 0.8%]

WHY IT MATTERS
This release is crucial for anyone watching USD/CAD. Economic performance guides central bank expectations, and any major deviation tends to shift rate bets fast.
[ON SCREEN: USD/CAD chart]

WHAT TO WATCH
Traders will watch for surprises. If growth lands well above 0.3%, the Canadian dollar could push higher against the greenback. But if the figure prints below expectations, USD/CAD could quickly find upward momentum as traders price in economic softness.
[ON SCREEN: Bullish vs Bearish reaction arrows for USD/CAD]

CLOSE
For the full breakdown and live market updates, head over to FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]

drafts.text:
HOOK
Is German consumer sentiment finally turning the corner ahead of the new month?
[ON SCREEN: Germany GfK Consumer Confidence / EUR/USD]

WHAT IT IS
Germany releases its GfK Consumer Confidence survey for Dec at 02:00 ET. Markets are looking for a print of -29.9, compared to -30.8 in the prior reading.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast -29.9 vs Previous -30.8]

WHY IT MATTERS
Germany is the powerhouse of the eurozone. When German households feel cautious, consumer spending slows. Currency traders follow this closely because consumer sentiment can weigh on economic growth and steer pairs like EUR/USD.
[ON SCREEN: EUR/USD Chart]

WHAT TO WATCH
A result coming in better than -29.9 could give EUR/USD a lift early in the session. But if the data misses, traders will watch for renewed pressure on the euro.
[ON SCREEN: Scenarios: Above -29.9 vs Below -29.9]

CLOSE
Get the full breakdown on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: Full analysis on FXEmpire]
